name: Nang Kwak
description: A benevolent female household deity of Thai folk religion, regarded as the patron of merchants and a bringer of customers and prosperity. Depicted as a beautiful woman in red Thai dress, kneeling, with her right hand raised in a beckoning gesture.

aliases.name: Nang Supawadee
aliases.meaning: name in the Buddhist origin legend

origin: Veneration is centered in Thailand and extends to ethnic-Thai and Chinese-Thai communities across Southeast Asia, with documented presence in Hong Kong.
